newsitem.title: FINLAND: Santa plans Kremlin summit with Grandfather Frost.
newsitem.headline: Santa plans Kremlin summit with Grandfather Frost.

text.p: Finland's Santa Claus said on Friday he planned to stage a historic "summit" with Russia's wizard of the new year Grandfather Frost in the Moscow Kremlin on January 7.
Santa said in a statement that the three-day meeting would "put the final icing on the cake of East-West relations".
The main topic of talks would be future cooperation, with a massive children's party also planned near Red Square, he said.
Finland, twice at war with its larger eastern neighbour, hosts some 400,000 visitors to Santa's arctic home yearly and claims to be home to the "real" Father Christmas.
"It's going to be a summit of genuine goodwill and friendship," Grandfather Frost said in the statement. Russia's Christmas holiday according to the Orthodox calendar falls on January 6 and 7.
